name: gradient-waves
title: Gradient Waves
description: A full-bleed shader seascape of soft purple waves rolling under a dark sky, lit by a low glow at the horizon. It drifts on its own and answers the pointer with slight parallax and click swells.
use: A full-bleed backdrop for a moody landing hero where headings sit over the dark sky.
avoid: The bright lower half fights text, and the raymarch shader is costly on phones.
a11y: The canvas is decorative and unnamed; reduced motion stills the waves and disables click swells. (keyboard: n-a, labels: none, reduced motion: respected)
looks: The lower frame is a violet sea whose waves rise into rounded ridges, catching pale lavender light on their faces and dropping into deep indigo troughs. Above them lies a flat black sky with a soft glow along the meeting line.
behaves: The surface rolls in slow, continuous swells, crests sliding past one another as light and shade travel across them. Moving the pointer tilts the view and shifts the light source; clicking lifts a local swell that grows and fades.
customise: Set horizon, wave, crest and background colours plus speed, amplitude, scale, tilt, zoom, fog, relief, light angle, grain and quality. Intro, parallax and click swell toggle too.
weight: heavy: A per-pixel raymarch of up to 120 steps runs across the whole screen every frame.
